_comment: Fixed user-facing texts of the finance package, English (docs/package-contract.md §3.11). Same keys + placeholders as de.json/ko.json (locale_lint).
finance.facts.finance_profile.title: Financial profile
finance.hitl.book_savings_reservation: Custody account reserve for the savings goal – please check:
finance.note.deviation_planned: ⚠ Deviation of more than 5 % from the planned amount
finance.enum.savings_move.relocate: Move between reserve accounts (balance stays the same)
finance.note.deviation_target: ⚠ Deviation of more than 5 % from the planned amount
finance.note.reserve_fixed: Note: The amount is the fixed reserve for the goal; the market value of the custody account only covers it and can fluctuate.
finance.note.quote_symbol_unverified: ⚠ Price symbol not verified – please check/adjust
finance.note.quote_symbol_foreign: There is no euro listing for this security: the price comes in {currency} and is converted to € for the overview. Your purchase price stays in euros.
finance.note.reconcile_closes_due: This reconciliation marks {n} open recurring booking(s) up to this date as done (e.g. a savings-plan execution). If one is really missing, book it first.
finance.note.reconcile_closes_due_accoun: {name}: this reconciliation marks {n} open recurring booking(s) up to this date as done (e.g. a savings-plan execution). If one is really missing, book it first.
finance.note.existing_position: Existing position: recorded at your purchase price; the settlement account is not debited.
finance.note.depot_number_stored: The account number {number} will be saved on the custody account “{depot}”. If this is not the account of this document, please cancel.
finance.note.iban_learned: The IBAN {iban} will be saved for this account. Future statements are matched by it. If it is wrong, please cancel.
finance.note.similar_entry: Note: “{name}” already exists with very similar details. If it is the same, please cancel.
finance.note.similar_account: Note: this bank already has the account “{name}” with the same owner. If it is the same account, please cancel.
finance.note.possible_duplicate: Note: exactly {amount} was already booked on this account on {date}. If it is the same booking, please cancel.
finance.note.similar_recurring_payment: Note: a payment “{name}” is already running as part of an insurance, loan or savings goal. If it is the same payment, please cancel.
finance.hitl.close_savings_goal_complete: Close savings goal as completed – please check:
finance.note.close_account_warning: WARNING: After closing, no further bookings are possible on this account.
finance.note.close_insurance_soft: The policy is cancelled (valid until today) and the premium is ended. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_insurance_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the policy and its premium are deleted completely.
finance.note.close_pension_soft: The pension is paused and the monthly contribution is ended. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_pension_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the pension and any linked contribution are deleted completely.
finance.note.close_goal_reserve_left: WARNING: There is still reserve left. Only confirm as completed if the money has already been spent – otherwise the closing is rejected (unless explicitly confirmed despite the remaining amount).
finance.note.close_goal_done: Action: close as completed (reserve used up). The booking history is kept.
finance.note.close_goal_cancel: Action: cancel — the goal is cancelled, the savings instalment is ended and the allocations are released (bookings stay as history). The balance is not touched.
finance.note.close_goal_delete: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the goal, its reserve allocation and the savings instalment are deleted. Account balances are not touched.
finance.note.close_plan_soft: The regular execution is ended (valid until today) and the plan is paused. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_plan_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the plan and its regular payment are deleted completely.
finance.note.import_all_or_nothing: All or nothing: if there are errors, NOTHING is booked.
finance.value.position_takeover: Existing holding taken over (no debit, settlement account unchanged)
finance.hitl.create_recurring_transfer: Set up recurring transfer – please check:
finance.tpl.credit_anniversary: on the anniversary of the start
finance.tpl.credit_start_day: on the day of the month of the start
finance.label.claim_deadline: Notification deadline in case of death
finance.label.balance_projected_fixed_un: Remaining debt at end of fixed rate (projected, without extra repayments)
finance.label.balance_projected_term_end: Remaining debt at end of term (projected, same rate, without extra repayments)
finance.value.disbursed_no: no (to a third party / already running)
finance.tpl.reserve_pot: {name} (the savings instalment becomes a transfer to it)
finance.tpl.cycle_days_split: every month on days {days} (from {date}; earlier dates keep the old schedule)
finance.note.delete_account_referenced: WARNING: The account is still referenced {count} times (bookings/loans/custody accounts/standing orders) → deletion will be rejected. Close an active account instead.
finance.note.delete_account_hard: WARNING: The empty account is deleted completely.
finance.note.delete_holding_rejected: WARNING: This holding has trades → deletion will be rejected (reverse the trades first).
finance.note.delete_holding_hard: WARNING: The (empty) position is deleted. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.delete_loan_rejected: WARNING: Instalments have already been booked → deletion will be rejected. To pay it off, settle the loan; to refinance, change the loan status to refinanced.
finance.note.delete_loan_hard: WARNING: The loan is removed completely – including its loan account, opening bookings and instalment. Current and payout accounts are kept.
finance.note.delete_re_rejected: WARNING: This property is linked to loans → deletion will be rejected (pay off or unlink the loans first).
finance.note.delete_re_hard: WARNING: The property is deleted completely.
finance.note.delete_rp_owned: WARNING: This standing order belongs to an entity (insurance/loan/retirement provision/savings goal/savings plan) → deletion will be rejected. Change or end it on the linked entity.
finance.note.delete_rp_booked: WARNING: There are booked occurrences → deletion will be rejected (reverse the bookings first).
finance.note.delete_rp_hard: WARNING: The standing order is deleted completely.
finance.tpl.reconcile_row_correction: System {db} → confirmed {confirmed} (diff {diff}, correction booking will be made)
finance.note.sell_re_action: Action: the proceeds are credited and the property is set to sold.
finance.note.sell_re_loans: WARNING: {count} linked active loan(s) remain — pay them off separately.
finance.note.settle_loan_action: Action: the remaining debt is booked down to 0, the loan is set to paid off and the instalment is ended.
finance.tpl.void_group: linked event (transfer/loan) – all {count} bookings are removed together.
finance.note.void_warning: This deletes the booking permanently; balances and holdings are recalculated automatically (the holding itself is kept).
finance.enum.ownership.joint_or: Joint account (either holder may act alone)
finance.note.set_interest_closes_open: A previously open interest rate is ended automatically on the valid-from date.
finance.note.set_insurance_pause: The premium ends with the end of the contract (without an end date: from today).
finance.tpl.new_amount_from_date: {amount} (from {date} – the existing line is ended on the effective date)
finance.tpl.new_amount_from_today: {amount} (from today, default – the existing line is ended on the effective date)
finance.tpl.link_savings_plan: {name} (purchases of this plan will in future feed this goal's custody account reserve)
finance.tpl.reserve_pot_set: {name} (future savings instalments go there; bookings already allocated stay with the goal and keep counting)
finance.value.stop_funders: The savings instalment and all linked savings plans are paused (goal and reserve are untouched — reached does not mean spent)
finance.note.set_goal_recalc: The monthly savings instalment is recalculated from the remaining amount / remaining time and the linked instalment is adjusted.
finance.tpl.amount_change_split: {from} → {to} (from {date}; earlier dates keep the old amount)
finance.tpl.cycle_split: every {interval} {unit} (from {date}; earlier dates keep the old schedule)
finance.note.set_plan_split: A change of amount/frequency creates a new recurring payment row; the old one is given an end date.
finance.package.name: Finances
finance.package.summary: Keep track of accounts, portfolio, loans, insurance and savings goals – plus financial advice and a financial plan
finance.help.accounts.title: Accounts
finance.help.accounts.description: Bank accounts, portfolios, fixed deposits: open, change, look up the current interest rate on the web, reconcile the balance, close.
finance.help.accounts.ex1: Close the Trade Republic Cash current account, closing date today.
finance.help.accounts.ex2: Open a new Comdirect current account, I am the holder, no interest.
finance.help.accounts.ex3: Reconcile my DKB Giro: according to the banking app the balance today is exactly 1,234.56 euros.
finance.help.bookings.title: Bookings & transfers
finance.help.bookings.description: Book expenses/income, transfer between your own accounts, reverse wrong bookings.
finance.help.bookings.ex1: I paid 85 euros for groceries with the DKB Giro today. Please book it as an expense.
finance.help.bookings.ex2: Transfer 500 euros from the DKB Giro to the Trade Republic Cash current account, date today.
finance.help.bookings.ex3: Reverse my last booking on the DKB Giro.
finance.help.securities.title: Portfolio & securities
finance.help.securities.description: Stock/ETF/crypto purchases and sales, dividends, savings plans.
finance.help.securities.ex1: Book a dividend of 12.50 euros for my Vanguard FTSE All-World position (VWCE) in the Trade Republic portfolio to the Trade Republic Cash current account, date today.
finance.help.securities.ex2: The broker executed my VWCE savings plan today: 0.44 shares at 113.50 euros per share, order fee 0 euros.
finance.help.securities.ex3: Buy 10 shares of Vanguard FTSE All-World (ISIN IE00BK5BQT80, symbol VWCE) in the Trade Republic portfolio at 110 euros per share, order fee 1 euro, purchase date today.
finance.help.loans.title: Loans
finance.help.loans.description: Record loans, book instalments, change terms, repay early.
finance.help.loans.ex1: Book the monthly instalment for my mortgage, instalment 1,200 euros, date today.
finance.help.loans.ex2: My ING mortgage has a new interest rate of 4.1% after the fixed-rate period ended. Please update it.
finance.help.insurance.title: Insurance
finance.help.insurance.description: Record policies with their premium, change them, cancel them.
finance.help.insurance.ex1: Cancel my HUK household contents insurance.
finance.help.insurance.ex2: Record a new liability insurance with HUK-COBURG, policy number HUK-9876, annual premium 89 euros, the holder is my wife, debited from the DKB Giro, valid from 1 Jan 2026, paid yearly on the 15th, first debit on 15 Jan 2026.
finance.help.insurance.ex3: The annual premium of my HUK household contents insurance goes up to 95 euros. Please update it.
finance.help.pension.title: Retirement provision
finance.help.pension.ex1: Record my Rürup pension with Allianz, current surrender value 12,000 euros (as of today), monthly contribution 200 euros from the DKB Giro, debit day 1.
finance.help.real_estate.title: Real estate
finance.help.real_estate.description: Add property as an asset, revalue it, sell it.
finance.help.real_estate.ex1: Please delete the property 'Musterimmobilie' completely from my net worth overview, I don't need it any more.
finance.help.real_estate.ex2: Update the value of my Musterimmobilie to 350,000 euros.
finance.help.savings_goals.title: Savings goals
finance.help.savings_goals.description: Savings goals with a target amount/date and an automatically calculated savings rate.
finance.help.savings_goals.ex1: Create a new savings goal 'Emergency fund': target 10,000 euros by the end of 2027, from the DKB Giro into Tagesgeld Plus, debit day 1, first booking on 1 Jul 2026.
finance.help.recurring.title: Standing orders
finance.help.recurring.description: Manage recurring payments (salary, rent, subscriptions, pension).
finance.help.recurring.ex1: Add a recurring expense: Netflix subscription, 13.99 euros monthly from the DKB Giro, debit day 5, first payment on 5 Jul 2026.
finance.help.recurring.ex2: Set up a monthly standing order: 200 euros from the DKB Giro to the Trade Republic Cash current account, from 1 Jul 2026, on the 1st of the month.
finance.help.import.title: Import
finance.help.import.description: Import bank statements/policies/pension statements as a photo or as bulk data.
finance.help.advice.title: Advice & planning
finance.help.advice.body: The financial adviser gives recommendations, answers “is it worth it?/should I?”, researches with dated sources on the web and maintains your financial plan (interview + quarterly review).
finance.help.queries.title: Questions & reports
finance.help.queries.body: Ask directly for figures: account balance, net worth overview, monthly cash flow, remaining debt (“what is my balance on the DKB Giro?”).
finance.dialog.book_failed: {name} could not be booked. Ask me in the chat about the current status.
finance.dialog.remind_tomorrow: I'll remind you about {name} again tomorrow.
finance.dialog.interest_ask:
Book the interest credit of {amount} to {account} for the period up to {period_end} (credited on {value_date})?

Different amount? Tap “No, different” and send me the correct amount.
finance.dialog.interest_defer: The interest credit for {account} is still open. Remind you again tomorrow or skip it for this period?
finance.dialog.monthly_check_intro: 📄 Monthly check: please send me the bank statement up to {date} for these accounts:
finance.dialog.monthly_check_howto:
How it works:
1. Open your online banking or banking app.
2. Under mailbox / documents, save the latest account statement as a PDF.
3. Send the PDF here in the chat – one statement per account, the next one only after you have confirmed the card.
I tick off your regular payments, book the rest as everyday spending and then tell you whether the money lasts until the next income.
finance.dialog.pension_statement_intro: 🧓 Pension check: these retirement provisions are missing a current pension statement:
finance.dialog.pension_statement_howto:
How it works:
1. Find the latest pension statement (Renteninformation / Standmitteilung) – for the statutory pension in the DRV mailbox (online services of the Deutsche Rentenversicherung) or in your letterbox.
2. Send the PDF or a photo here in the chat.
I read the figures (claim, projection, both scenarios, disability pension) and, once you confirm, save them with their date – so you can see how they develop over the years.
finance.gate.onboarding_required: Before I can give you sound advice, I need your financial picture first. Send me /onboarding (or simply: set me up).
finance.advisor.savings_pace: Savings goal “{name}”: {drift} percentage points behind plan (currently {progress} %, expected {expected} %).
finance.advisor.savings_pace_catchup: Required catch-up rate: {rate} per month to keep the target date.
finance.advisor.savings_pace_projected: At the current pace it will be reached around {date}.
finance.advisor.goal_reached: Savings goal “{name}” reached ({saved} of {target}). Options: close it (use the reserve first), secure the gains, or raise the target. Note: the amount stays reserved until you use it – reached is not spent.
finance.advisor.goal_exceeded: Savings goal “{name}” reached and exceeded ({saved} of {target}). Options: close it (use the reserve first), secure the gains, or raise the target. Note: the amount stays reserved until you use it – reached is not spent.
finance.advisor.reserve_coverage: Reserve shortfall: the balance no longer covers the money set aside for savings goals (accounts: {accounts}).
finance.advisor.reserve_coverage_levers: Levers: reprioritise, extend a target date, raise the catch-up rate, or move the reserve.
finance.advisor.depot_reserve: Depot reserve short: {reserved} is reserved against the depot “{account}” for “{goals}”, but its market value is only {market} (gap {gap}), and the current savings rate will not close it in time. Levers: top up, lower the reserve, extend the target date, raise the rate, or secure gains (sell depot → cash; note: the Abgeltungssteuer on realised gains reduces the amount actually secured).
finance.advisor.depot_reserve_fx_missing: IMPORTANT: the market value of this depot can NOT be determined right now (live price or exchange rate missing) – coverage cannot be determined reliably, so this is NOT yet a confirmed shortfall. Add the price/exchange rate, then check again.
finance.advisor.depot_reserve_fx_note: Note: the depot holds foreign-currency positions – the EUR coverage also moves with the exchange rate.
finance.advisor.plan_stale: Financial plan not confirmed for {days} days (threshold {threshold} days).
finance.advisor.tax_year: New tax year: check the Basiszins/Vorabpauschale and your Freistellungsauftrag (the Basiszins changes every year → otherwise the Vorabpauschale debit in January can needlessly exceed your allowance). Plan last confirmed in {year}.
finance.advisor.risk_profile_stale: Risk profile not confirmed for {days} days (threshold {threshold} days) – briefly check risk appetite and capacity.
finance.advisor.account_coverage: Account running low: “{account}” is projected to drop to {min} on {date}, below your buffer of {buffer}. The outlook uses the planned payments until the next incoming money and your usual everyday spending from recent bank statements.
finance.advisor.recurring_missing: “{name}” ({amount}) did not leave the account twice in a row, last due on {date}. Cancelled or switched provider? Then end the recurring payment, otherwise please check.
finance.advisor.cashflow_deficit: Cash-flow deficit: your fixed obligations (spending and loan instalments, {obligations}) exceed income ({income}) by {deficit} per month. Savings rates are not included. Levers: cut expenses, raise income, or refinance a loan.
finance.advisor.cashflow_buffer: Thin cash-flow buffer: after spending and loan instalments only {free} per month remain free ({pct} % of income, target {target} %) – little room for saving or reserves. Levers: cut expenses or raise income.
finance.advisor.savings_squeeze: Over-saving: your savings rates ({saving}) are higher than what remains free after spending and loan instalments ({free}) – your current account shrinks by {gap} per month. Levers: lower or pause the savings rate, cut expenses, or raise income.
finance.advisor.cashflow_fx_gap: Note: an exchange rate is missing for at least one recurring payment – this figure is incomplete.
finance.advisor.savings_goal_unmeasurabl: Savings goal “{name}”: progress cannot be measured – the savings rate does not flow into a savings account, it is only debited. Assign a savings account to the goal, then every instalment counts towards progress.
finance.advisor.target_portfolio: Target portfolio: {value} of {target} ({gap} missing to the target range).
finance.advisor.dq_null_rate: {n} foreign currency(ies) without an exchange rate (amounts not yet converted to EUR);
finance.advisor.digest_no_plan: No financial plan has been published yet – the check only shows the key figures.
finance.advisor.digest_cashflow: Monthly cash flow: income {income} · spending {consumption} · repayment {principal} → free {free} · saving {saving} → account {account_change}
finance.advisor.digest_goal_line_unmeasu: - {name}: progress not measurable (target {target}, no savings account assigned)
finance.advisor.digest_reserve_heading: Reserve breakdown (where the goal money sits):
finance.advisor.digest_price_stale: (Note: price data is stale or missing – allocation may be inaccurate.)
finance.advisor.digest_p2p: (Note: P2P (e.g. Bondora) counts at face value in the target portfolio – market value/default risk not considered.)
finance.advisor.target_portfolio_fx_gap: Note: this value is incomplete because an exchange rate is missing.
finance.advisor.digest_alloc_outside: (Outside the plan, not compared: {value} – e.g. cash without a cash block or positions without a matching block.)
finance.advisor.digest_real_estate_value: (Note: a property with a loan has no value recorded – net worth is computed without this property and without its loan.)
finance.hitl.void_bank_statement: Take back the last bank statement – please check:
finance.note.statement_drift: Before this period the balance in the system did not match the statement. The difference is booked as a separate correction on the day before.
finance.label.statement_missing: Not on the statement (will be skipped)
finance.label.statement_not_booked: Not booked automatically (counts toward the rest)
finance.note.statement_lump: Everything else on the statement is not stored line by line but booked as one total. Afterwards the balance matches the statement.
finance.note.statement_void: The balance goes back to where it was before this statement. You can then send the statement again.
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.label: Monthly check (bank statements)
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.on_messa: Monthly check on: on the 3rd and 17th I remind you about missing bank statements.
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.off_mess: Monthly check off: I will no longer remind you about bank statements.
finance.cron.remind_pension_statement.on: Pension check on: when a pension statement is older than a year, I remind you.
finance.cron.remind_pension_statement.of: Pension check off: I will no longer remind you about pension statements.
finance.cron.remind_interest.label: Book interest credits
finance.cron.remind_interest.on_message: Interest reminder on: when an interest credit is due, I ask whether to book it.
finance.cron.remind_interest.off_message: Interest reminder off: you now book interest credits yourself, or they come in with the bank statement.
